purpose: Expose current ATS/ETS coverage without converting incomplete executable coverage into a conformance failure.

semantics.instruction_direct_ats: Counts only ATS objects whose governing_object_id is the instruction ID; semantic similarity is never inferred.
semantics.ats_ets: Counts only ETS objects whose ats_id names the ATS.
semantics.no_direct_ats: A visibility state, not a defect by itself.
semantics.no_ets: A visibility state, not a defect by itself; human verification may remain legitimate where the ATS permits it.
semantics.coverage_is_not_authority: The inventory reports repository relationships only and creates no requirement or implementation obligation.

generation.method: Repository-local relationship scan using governing_object_id and ats_id; no inferred semantic links.
